institutional-names-slower.title: Mentioning specific institutional or brand names predicts slower funding regardless of gender.
institutional-names-slower.body: Pitches that reference specific financial institutions or brands tend to fund more slowly for both men and women.

female-savings-dreams-slower.title: Female borrowers who mention dreams or future aspirations predict slower funding.
female-savings-dreams-slower.body: Pitches from women that focus on dreams, aspirations, or the goal of saving money tend to fund more slowly.

female-technical-specificity-faster.title: Female borrowers who list specific products or goals beyond family welfare fund faster.
female-technical-specificity-faster.body: Pitches from women that detail specific business inputs or concrete objectives beyond general family security accelerate funding.

female-age-slower.title: Female borrowers who explicitly state their age fund more slowly.
female-age-slower.body: Pitches from women that include the borrower's age tend to fund more slowly than those that omit it.

female-detailed-background-slower.title: Female borrowers who provide detailed personal backstories fund more slowly.
female-detailed-background-slower.body: Pitches from women that include extensive details about their origins or personal history tend to decelerate funding.

female-financial-specificity-slower.title: Female borrowers who mention specific local currency amounts or loan counts fund more slowly.
female-financial-specificity-slower.body: Pitches from female borrowers that specify exact loan amounts in local currency tend to fund more slowly.

female-business-expansion-faster.title: Female borrowers who mention building or expanding their business to secure their family fund faster.
female-business-expansion-faster.body: Pitches from women that emphasize business development and growth as a means to provide family security accelerate funding speed.

female-business-duration-faster.title: Female borrowers who specify the number of years the business has operated fund faster.
female-business-duration-faster.body: Pitches from women that include the duration of their business operations tend to accelerate funding speed.

hardship-gender-interaction.body: Details regarding personal hardships may accelerate funding for women but slow it for men.

female-ag-success-slower.body: Mentioning previous business success in agricultural pitches may predict slower funding for women.

female-professional-values-faster.body: Female borrowers who mention professional values, such as customer service, may fund faster.

male-length-slower.body: Pitches from male borrowers that are longer in length may predict slower funding.

male-equipment-specificity-slower.body: Mentioning specific equipment models or electronics may predict slower funding for male borrowers.

female-gratitude-faster-v3.body: Specific expressions of gratitude to lenders may accelerate funding for female borrowers.

female-hardworking-faster-v2.body: Describing the borrower as hardworking may accelerate funding for female borrowers.

female-child-count-slower.body: Specifying the number of children may predict slower funding for female borrowers.

female-geographic-specificity-faster-v2.body: Mentioning specific geographic locations may accelerate funding for female borrowers.

female-past-loans-faster.title: Pitches from women that reference the use of past loans to maintain their business tend to accelerate funding.
female-past-loans-faster.retrospective: Retired to make room for promoted financial specificity claim due to memory cap.

female-geographic-specificity-faster.title: Providing specific geographic locations or settlement names may predict faster funding for female borrowers.
female-geographic-specificity-faster.retrospective: Dropped from puzzles to make room for gratitude puzzle.

female-gratitude-faster-revisited.title: Explicit thank yous to lenders may accelerate funding for female borrowers.
female-gratitude-faster-revisited.retrospective: Dropped to make room for business sustainability puzzle.

female-hardworking-slower.title: Describing oneself as a hardworking entrepreneur may predict slower funding for women.
female-hardworking-slower.retrospective: Retired to make room for new puzzle female-credit-history-faster.

female-credit-history-faster.title: Mentioning a good credit history may predict faster funding for female borrowers.
female-credit-history-faster.retrospective: Dropped to make room for male-length-slower puzzle.

female-business-sustainability-faster.title: Focusing on business sustainability or progress may predict faster funding for female borrowers.
female-business-sustainability-faster.retrospective: Dropped to make room for male-equipment-specificity-slower puzzle.

female-social-goals-faster.title: Female borrowers who mention children's education or food security fund faster.
female-social-goals-faster.retrospective: Retired to make room for promoted loan amount claim due to memory cap.

female-loan-amount-faster.title: Pitches from women requesting smaller loan amounts in local currency tend to accelerate funding speed.
female-loan-amount-faster.retrospective: Retired to make room for promoted business expansion claim due to memory cap.

female-children-gender-faster.title: Specifying the gender of children may predict faster funding for female borrowers.
female-children-gender-faster.retrospective: Retired to make room for new child-count puzzle and geographic puzzle due to contradiction and memory cap.

environmental-protection-slower.title: Pitches that focus on environmental or ecological concerns tend to fund more slowly for both men and women.
environmental-protection-slower.retrospective: Retired to make room for promoted female-business-duration-faster claim due to memory cap.
